purpose: Persist the formal sash-latch evidence epoch across Unity script/assembly reloads so replacement/deleted generated lock geometry cannot be accepted as a fresh reflection baseline merely because static fields reset. The first clean-session baseline may prepare a genuinely missing generated latch through the canonical parent builder. After epoch arm, scene GUID, authored/fallback mode and the generated root stable GlobalObjectId are frozen and every reflection request/poll/completion/pre-still check is read-only. This is evidence-integrity infrastructure only and awards zero Visual Fidelity points.
limitations: Stable root identity proves which persisted latch assembly entered the reflection evidence epoch; it does not prove that the reconstructed lock dimensions look proportionate in pixels.

The delegated parent validator proves 30 lock assemblies, canonical materials, metric UV payload, weathering metadata and four LOD levels; it cannot prove highlight smoothness, receiver contact, aliasing or repetition without rendered evidence.
SessionState survives script/assembly reloads only within the current Unity Editor session. A clean Editor restart is the conservative boundary for a new formal evidence epoch.
The binding deliberately rejects unsaved replacement roots that do not have a stable GlobalObjectId; temporary hierarchy state is not scoreable provenance.
The binding never repairs a deleted/replaced latch after epoch arm. Corrective geometry work requires a clean new evidence epoch and fresh reflection capture.
Unity 6000.3.0f1 compilation/runtime behavior and actual native 3840x2160 latch appearance remain PENDING_UNITY_RUNTIME; no Visual Fidelity PASS may be inferred from this contract.
